lead: Harbhajan Singh has built a public profile as an Indian cricketer, born on 3 July 1980 in Jalandhar.
As of 2026, he is 46 years old, and his birth date places him under the Cancer sign.
He has represented India national cricket team and Surrey County Cricket Club and has held the office of member of Rajya Sabha.
The sections that follow break down Harbhajan Singh's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Harbhajan Singh — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Harbhajan Singh was born on 3 July 1980 in Jalandhar, and holds Indian nationality.

sections.heading: Harbhajan Singh — Career and Professional Work
paras: Harbhajan Singh works primarily as a cricketer, politician and actor.

On the team sheet, Harbhajan has been associated with India national cricket team (from 1998 to 2015), Surrey County Cricket Club (from 2005 to 2007), Mumbai Indians (from 2008 to 2017) and Chennai Super Kings (from 2018 to 2000).
He has held the following offices: member of Rajya Sabha (2022–present). He is affiliated with Aam Aadmi Party.
He has taken part in 1998 Commonwealth Games.
